name: beyond_create_relationships
description: Create FK relationships. Prefer explicit child_entity_id/child_attribute_ids and parent_entity_id/parent_attribute_ids, plus required relationship_type. Parent IDs must cover the complete PK; child IDs are reused, not duplicated. Legacy from_entity_id=child, to_entity_id=parent; legacy to_attribute_ids (without from_attribute_ids) unusually denotes CHILD FK IDs. Paired from_attribute_ids/to_attribute_ids instead belongs to each matching entity. cardinality alone is insufficient; choose optional/mandatory/identifying explicitly. The tool creates the FK constraint and RELATION references; do not duplicate them with beyond_add_constraints. Each relationship is atomic; inspect created_relationships and failed, retry only failed items. on_delete/on_update are NOT supported BE relationship behavior settings. Inputs are preserved only as reference metadata in relationship other_info. Creation and FK/relationship reads return other_info and metadata_guide when these keys are present. They may inform source SQL analysis or code/DDL authoring; BE does not apply or guarantee these rules. relationship_description remains the separate supported relationship description. Large responses use paged delivery even when the operation partially or fully failed. In a paged response outer success is page-delivery status only; inspect data.operation_status.success/is_error, failed_count and bounded failed_preview immediately. Retrieve and assemble ALL page_content fragments to obtain complete created objects, ID mappings and failed entries. Retry only failed items, never the entire partially successful batch.

relationship_type.description: Required. Cardinality alone cannot determine optionality or identifying semantics. Choose one of the listed values explicitly.

from_entity_id.description: Child/referencing entity ID. Use this instead of from_table_name when you already have the entity ID.

to_entity_id.description: Parent/referenced entity ID. Use this instead of to_table_name when you already have the entity ID.

to_column_name.description: (Optional) Existing child table column name(s) to reuse for FK mapping. If omitted, new child FK columns are created based on the parent PK.

to_attribute_ids.description: Legacy form (no from_attribute_ids): CHILD FK IDs, despite the to_ prefix. Paired form with from_attribute_ids: PARENT PK IDs. Prefer explicit parent_attribute_ids/child_attribute_ids.

parent_entity_id.description: Explicit parent entity ID. Parent owns the PK; child owns the FK.

parent_attribute_ids.description: Existing parent attribute IDs, in matching pair order. Parent must supply the complete PK.

child_entity_id.description: Explicit child entity ID. Parent owns the PK; child owns the FK.

child_attribute_ids.description: Existing child attribute IDs, in matching pair order. Parent must supply the complete PK.

from_attribute_ids.description: Paired from/to form: CHILD FK IDs; to_attribute_ids then denotes PARENT PK IDs. Without this field, legacy to_attribute_ids denotes CHILD FK IDs.

on_delete.description: on_delete/on_update are NOT supported BE relationship behavior settings. Inputs are preserved only as reference metadata in relationship other_info. Creation and FK/relationship reads return other_info and metadata_guide when these keys are present. They may inform source SQL analysis or code/DDL authoring; BE does not apply or guarantee these rules. relationship_description remains the separate supported relationship description.

auto_created_child_attribute_ids.description: Child FK attributes automatically created by beyond_create_relationships. Do not create these again.

reused_child_attribute_ids.description: Existing child attributes reused for the FK mapping.

created_relationships.description: Batch-created relationships. Each item includes foreign_key when the relationship was created successfully.

relationship_description.description: Stored relationship description, separate from referential-action metadata.

other_info.description: Preserved relationship metadata. on_delete/on_update are reference annotations, not supported BE behaviors.

metadata_guide.description: Present when on_delete or on_update metadata exists; explains that BE does not support or apply these behavior settings.

relationship_foreign_key.description: ForeignKey constraint and child FK attributes created or reused by beyond_create_relationships. This FK is relationship-owned; do not recreate it with beyond_add_constraints.
